thread:
Priya: Quick thread  proposing a staged rollback lattice for EU model-v2 rollout. Goal: allow fine-grained rollback slices (tenant, region, feature-path) instead of all-or-nothing. Sketch below.
Marco: Love the lattice idea. Can you define dimensions? I think at minimum: region, tenant-cohort, and api-path (chat vs embeddings).
Tina: Agreed. Also add "compatibility-mode" dimension so we can fall back to a v1-compatible decoding path for quality regressions while keeping latency benefits.
Will: Rollout plan I'd run: 1) QA header slices for 2h. 2) Cohort canary 10% (mix of low-risk & feature-heavy tenants) for 6h + 4h shadow at 5%. 3) Expand to 50% then 100% conditional on lattice gates.
Priya: Lattice gates (proposal): for each dimension we evaluate specific signals. Region gate: region_error_rate <0.5% and p95 < baseline+150ms. Tenant gate: per-tenant rerank_delta <0.12 and error_rate <0.4%. API-path gate: embeddings drift <0.08 and token_cost delta <20%. All gates must be green for a full promote; partial promotes allowed by lattice rules.
Marco: How do partial promotes work? e.g., if embeddings path fails but chat is fine?
Tina: Partial promote: route chat traffic to v2 but embeddings requests keep using v1. That requires routing policy aware of request_path header. Use X-Redwood-API: chat|embed.
Will: Flag schema: flag_id="eu_model_v2_lattice" fields: mode (header|cohort|pct), lattice_exempt_tenants, enabled_dimensions=[region,tenant,api_path,compat_mode], shadow_pct, warmup_secs. Console should render lattice matrix and per-cell state.
Priya: Deterministic routing: support headers X-RW-Slice and X-RW-Tenant for seeded QA. Also X-RW-Force-Compat=true to force compatibility path for repro.
Marco: Automated rollback rules: if any cell in the lattice breaches its threshold, only that cell is rolled back to v1 or compat-mode. Escalation: if >30% of cells fail within 30m, trigger region-wide rollback. Each automated action must emit rollout-audit event with reason and metric snapshot.
Tina: Circuit timers: cell-level rollback opens for 45m and blocks auto-promote for that cell for 3h. Region rollback opens for 1h and requires manual re-eval. Quarantine list persists 24h by default.
Will: Telemetry: tag requests with variant, lattice_cell (region:tenant:api), tenant_id, slice_id, trace_id. Emit minute pings per cell with p50/p95/error/token_cost/rerank_delta/embedding_cosine.
Priya: A/B test angle: we can run an A/B across compat_mode vs full_v2 within low-risk tenants to measure quality tradeoffs. Add ab_group tag and collect downstream CTR where available.
Marco: Health probe: /health?variant=v2&cell=<cell> returns version, recent_p95, kv_cache_hit. k8s readiness should call cell-specific probe when routing that cell.
Tina: Shadowing: async mirror with X-RW-Shadow: true. Store to shadow-index per-cell. Run offline comparisons daily during rollout and trigger a warning if mean rerank_delta>0.10 or embedding drift>0.09.
Will: Ops request: provide a small CLI helper to list lattice state and run synthetic checks per cell: `rw rollout status --cell region=eu-west-1,tenant=cohort-3,api=embed`.
OpsBot: job-20121 started: creating lattice flag eu_model_v2_lattice mode=cohort value=10% with enabled_dimensions=[region,tenant,api_path]. apply-step-1 OK.
Priya: Action items: 1) Priya to draft RFC describing lattice dimensions, thresholds, and UI mocks (due tomorrow). 2) Marco to add header routing + health probes. 3) Tina to implement cell-level rollback automation + audit events. 4) Will to build CLI helper + synthetic jobs for per-cell checks. 5) OpsBot to run a 6h shadow window once flag applied.
Marco: I'll also prepare a short runbook for support to repro issues using force headers.
Tina: I'll add a small table in the RFC with threshold values and escalation paths.
Will: Let's schedule a 30m shiproom after RFC is posted.
Priya: Thanks all  posting RFC by EOD unless objections. :thumbsup:
